description.narrative: Project Objectives and Description. The objective of the Project is to establish acceptable audit practices in line with international standards and improve quality of services provided by the accountancy profession in Senegal. The Project consists of the following parts: Part A: Adapting the Local Audit Standards to ISA and General Professional Guidelines and Ethical Code of IFAC Provide support to Order National des Experts Comptables et Comptables Agréés (ONECCA) to adapt the auditing standards of International Standards on Auditing (ISA) and general professional guidelines and ethical code of International Federation of Accountants (IFAC) by: (a) reviewing the existing national standards and code of ethics in line with ISA and IFAC's code of ethics; (b) disseminating and promoting the standards and; (c) capacity building of ONECCA members on ISA and International Financing Reporting Standards (IFRS). all of the above through the provision of technical advisory services, goods, and training and workshops. Part B: Establishment of Audit Quality Review Schemes Provide support in establishing an Audit Quality Review (AQR) scheme for adherence with IFAC standards through: (a) drafting of curriculum; (b) capacity building of ONECCA members for peer review practice of audit control system; and (c) printing and dissemination of AQR manual and guidelines. all of the above through provision of technical advisory services, goods, and training and workshops. Part C: Enhancing the Capacity of Local Training Institutions Provide support to: (a) at least three local training institutions to be accredited with Diplome d'Expertise Comptable et Financiere (DECOFI) and to enable these institutions to deliver DECOFI services through establishment of a local area network system, website, and database for membership information; and (b) review the curricula of Le Conseil d'Administration du Centre Africain D'Etudes Supérieures (CESAG) to make the accounting and auditing degree program more accessible. all of the above through the provision of technical advisory services, goods, and training. The overall objective of the IDF grant is to establish acceptable audit practices in line with international standards and improve quality of services provided by the Accountancy profession in Senegal.
